DataBall.Open(pointer) opens the named generation read-only (writable throws), retries once if it vanished, and exposes OpenedSnapshot; ReadSnapshotGeneration reads the pointer only for polling. FileGate narrowed to reserve-then-release, so other sessions are not blocked during a copy; a second save to, or an open of, a file being saved now throws at once. Pause ~80 ms per publish at 1M rows, same as SaveAsync. Release suite 780 passed (736 + 44), format clean.
